mainEntity.name: When and Where Is PACK EXPO International 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: PACK EXPO International 2026 runs October 18 to 21, 2026, at McCormick Place in Chicago, Illinois. TRF is at booth N-5660. The show page on this site links to TRF's PACK EXPO page, where you plan your visit and request a meeting, and the contact page also reaches the team before you arrive.

mainEntity.name: Who From Your Plant Should Attend a Supplier Meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The people who will own the decision: the plant or operations manager for throughput and labor, engineering for layout and integration, maintenance for access and support, and procurement or finance for scope and payback. If only one person travels, collect the other departments' questions beforehand so the meeting answers them all.

mainEntity.name: Can You Discuss a Frozen or Washdown Application at a Trade Show?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Bring the actual temperature of the area, whether cases arrive frosted, how often the line is cleaned and with what method. TRFSubzero covers palletizing areas below 32°F, and TRFCleanflow covers exposed food in dry-clean and washdown versions, so those details tell the team which platform and which version to discuss with you.
